DriveTunes is free and open source. You can read the code, report issues and contribute on GitHub.
DriveTunes doesn\'t collect, send or share any personal data. The app has no internet permission, no account or sign-in, no ads, and no analytics or trackers. Everything stays on your phone.

• Music files (audio permission): to list and play the songs on your phone. Files are never uploaded or copied.
• Bluetooth (nearby devices permission): to list your paired devices and detect when the device you chose (your car, for example) connects, so music can start automatically.
• Notifications: to show playback controls and the "tap to play" prompt.
• Battery optimization exemption (optional): so auto-play keeps working while the app is closed.
What is stored on your device

Only your settings and listening details: selected Bluetooth devices, chosen folder, sort order, favorites, songs excluded from random play, play counts, and the last song played with its position. This data is stored locally, is never sent anywhere by the app, and is deleted when you clear the app\'s data or uninstall it. If your phone\'s system backup is turned on, Android may include this data in it; that is controlled by your device, not by DriveTunes.

DriveTunes contains no third-party services that collect data. Links on this screen (Facebook, GitHub) open in your browser or the related app, which follow their own privacy policies. Feedback emails are sent through your own email app and contain only what you write. Donations are public blockchain transfers made outside the app; the app doesn\'t process payments or collect any wallet details.
DriveTunes is open source. The complete source code is public on GitHub (github.com/H-H-ps/DriveTunes), so you can verify everything stated here yourself, report issues, or contribute.
If this policy changes, the updated version will ship with a new app version. Questions? Write to hh.programming.services@gmail.com.
